shared.formErrorsSummary: We couldn't submit the form. {count, plural, =0 {Please try again.} one {Fix # field below.} other {Fix # fields below.}}

passwordRules.hint: At least 12 characters. A long password beats a complicated one.
passwordRules.tooShort: The password needs at least 12 characters. {count, plural, =0 {The field is still empty.} one {You entered # character.} other {You entered # characters.}}
passwordRules.tooLong: The password can have at most 256 characters.
passwordRules.tooCommon: This password is among the ten thousand most common ones. Pick another.
passwordRules.containsEmail: The password can't contain part of your email address.

fieldErrors.emailInvalid: This email doesn't look right. Check it for typos, a missing @ for example.
fieldErrors.workspaceNameRequired: Name the project, after your company or website for example.
fieldErrors.tokenRequired: The link is incomplete. Please open it again from the email.

setup.title: Create your account and first project
setup.lead: This installation has no users yet. Create the admin account and the first project, it takes a minute.
setup.workspaceHint: A project is a separate space with its own contacts, campaigns, and keys. You can have several later.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Enter the email and password you were invited with.

forgot.title: Forgotten password
forgot.lead: Enter your email and we'll send a link that sets a new password. The link works for 60 minutes.
forgot.sentTitle: The link is on its way
forgot.sentBody: If an account with this address exists, we've sent it a link to set a new password. The link works for 60 minutes. We answer the same way for addresses we don't know, so nobody can find out who has an account here.
forgot.cliBody: On a fresh installation with no sending set up yet, the link cannot be delivered. Set the password on the server instead:

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.lead: Enter a new password. Once you save it, we'll sign you out of every other device.
reset.doneBody: We ended the other sessions for safety. Sign in with the new password.
reset.invalidBody: A password link works for 60 minutes and can be used once. Yours is older, or it has already been used. Ask for a new one.

invitation.title: Invitation to the {projectName} project
invitation.leadSignedIn: You're signed in as {email}. Accepting gives you the {role} role in the {projectName} project.
invitation.leadSignedOut: Sign in or create an account, then accept the invitation.
invitation.invalidBody: An invitation works for 7 days and can be used once. Yours is older, was revoked, or someone has already accepted it. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
invitation.otherEmailNote: The invitation went to {invitedEmail} and you're signed in as {email}. You can still accept it, we'll record both addresses.

noWorkspace.title: You have no access to any project
noWorkspace.body: You have no access to any project. Ask for an invitation or create your own.

invalidCredentials.title: That email and password don't match
invalidCredentials.body: Check the address for typos and make sure Caps Lock is off. If you can't recall the password, have us send a link for a new one.

accountLocked.title: We locked the account for a while
accountLocked.body: After ten failed attempts we lock an account for 15 minutes so nobody can guess the password. Try again once the time is up, or set a new password meanwhile.

rateLimited.title: You're trying too often
rateLimited.body: Too many attempts came from your address in a short time. Wait {seconds, plural, =0 {a moment} one {# second} other {# seconds}} and try again.

unauthenticated.title: You're not signed in
unauthenticated.body: This page is for signed-in people only. Sign in and we'll take you where you were heading.

sessionExpired.title: You've been signed out
sessionExpired.body: We signed you out after a period of inactivity for security reasons. Sign in again, your work in progress is safe.

setupAlreadyCompleted.title: This installation is already set up
setupAlreadyCompleted.body: Someone created the first account earlier. Sign in, or ask for an invitation.

validationFailed.title: We couldn't submit the form
validationFailed.body: We've described what needs fixing next to the fields below.

notFound.title: We don't know this page
notFound.body: The link may be old or missing a character. Try signing in and starting again.

gone.title: This link no longer works
gone.body: The link has expired. Request a new one.

serviceUnavailable.title: The server isn't responding
serviceUnavailable.body: We couldn't reach the tool's server. This is usually temporary and a second attempt goes through.

systemMailUnavailable.title: This installation cannot send email about accounts
systemMailUnavailable.body: So we have no way to send you a password reset. Ask the installation administrator to set a password for you with mlain reset-password. Trying again will not help, what is missing is configuration, not a connection.

dependencyTimeout.title: The server took too long
dependencyTimeout.body: We stopped the request because it ran longer than 10 seconds. Try again.

internalError.title: Something went wrong
internalError.body: The fault is on our side. Try again, and if it keeps happening, send support the request number below.

fallback.title: Something went wrong
fallback.body: The server's description of the error is below. If it doesn't help, send support the request number.
